Part Number: TCX-280DF
                                                        SPARKLE Thunderbolt™ 5 eGPU Creator Station, Thunderbolt™ 5 80/120
                                                        Gbps, Built-in NVIDIA RTX 3060 12GB, USB 3.2 & 2.5 Gbps Ethernet Ports,
                                                        Windows 11/10 Compatible, TCX-280DF
                                                        Elevate your creative workflow with the Creator Station, the ultimate Thunderbolt 5 external GPU box
                                                        tailored for high-end content creation. Featuring a built-in GPU and four DisplayPort 1.4 outputs, plus an
                                                        ultra-fast Thunderbolt 5 downstream port, it empowers you to drive up to five displays simultaneously for
                                                        an expansive, uninterrupted canvas. Beyond visual mastery, the Creator Station delivers robust Power
                                                        Delivery (PD) to charge your pro-grade laptop through a single cable, ensuring your workstation remains
                                                        clutter-free while providing the raw power needed for intensive video editing, 3D rendering, and
                                                        multitasking.
